newsitem.title: UK: UK Oftel gives guidelines on enforcing fair trade.
newsitem.headline: UK Oftel gives guidelines on enforcing fair trade.

text.p: Britain's telecommunications watchdog Oftel published guidelines for enforcing fair trading on Tuesday, saying they would be reviewed at least once a year.
"The guidelines will continue to evolve with developments in the telecommunications sector. We expect to review the guidelines at least once a year," Oftel said in a statement.
The guidelines show how the new licence condition prohibiting anti-competitive behaviour in the telecoms industry will be enforced.
